# ShopCardHub

> Price indices for Pokémon TCG sets and Bowman 1st autos. Each index is the cost of one copy of every card in a set, set to 100 at a base month and re-marked on sold prices. Last mark: Nov 5, 2026.

Every index level is a dated read of completed sales. Where a page shows a listing price it is labelled an ask. Pages track prices; they do not tell anyone to buy or sell.

## Start here
- [Home: the index board](https://www.shopcardhub.com)
- [All indices, ranked by 1-week, 1-month and 3-month move](https://www.shopcardhub.com/indices)
- [How the indices are priced](https://www.shopcardhub.com/how-prices-work)
- [Release calendar](https://www.shopcardhub.com/release-calendar)
- [Track record](https://www.shopcardhub.com/track-record)

## Questions answered here
- [Is the Pokémon card market up or down?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/indices): In the latest month of marks, newer Pokémon sets were down and vintage WOTC sets were mostly up. All eight Pokémon sets released in 2025 and 2026 fell, by 7.4% to 21.5%. Of the ten Unlimited WOTC sets from 1999 to 2003, seven rose and three fell, from −5.6% to +16.3%. All three 2026 1st Bowman Chrome Auto indices fell, by 14.9% to 24.8%. Each move compares an index's latest mark (Nov 2 or Nov 5, 2026) with its mark 27 to 41 days before. Levels come from dated sold prices and start at 100 in a base month.
- [What are Pokémon Base Set (Unlimited) cards selling for?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/pokemon-base-set-index): The BS99 index stood at 124.58 on Nov 5, 2026 (100 = Jan 2021), across 101 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $1,083. Over the latest month it moved −3.3% (from Oct 8, 2026).
- [What are Pokémon Base Set 1st Edition cards selling for?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/pokemon-base-set-1st-edition-index): The BS1E index stood at 210.80 on Nov 5, 2026 (100 = Jan 2021), across 102 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $17,828. Over the latest month it moved −19.9% (from Oct 1, 2026).
- [What are Pokémon 151 (Scarlet & Violet 151) cards selling for?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/scarlet-violet-151-index): The SV151 index stood at 153.25 on Nov 5, 2026 (100 = Sep 2023), across 207 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $1,656. Over the latest month it moved −8.4% (from Oct 8, 2026).
- [Are 2026 1st Bowman Chrome Auto prices going up or down?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/bowman-1st-chrome-index): The BOW26 index stood at 57.55 on Nov 5, 2026 (100 = May 2026), across 162 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $2,304. Over the latest month it moved −19.7% (from Oct 8, 2026).
- [Are Prismatic Evolutions chase card prices going up or down?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/prismatic-evolutions-index): The PRIS25 index stood at 60.63 on Nov 2, 2026 (100 = Jan 2025), across 49 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $3,576. Over the latest month it moved −14.7% (from Oct 5, 2026).
- [Are Ascended Heroes chase card prices going up or down?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/ascended-heroes-index): The AH26 index stood at 61.38 on Nov 2, 2026 (100 = Feb 2026), across 70 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $3,626. Over the latest month it moved −21.5% (from Oct 5, 2026).
- [What are Evolving Skies cards selling for, Umbreon VMAX #215 included?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/evolving-skies-index): The EVS21 index stood at 259.63 on Nov 5, 2026 (100 = Sep 2021), across 237 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $6,632. Over the latest month it moved −5.4% (from Oct 6, 2026).
- [Are 2026 Bowman Chrome (September) 1st Bowman Chrome Auto prices going up or down?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/bowman-chrome-2026-index): The BCB26 index stood at 58.31 on Nov 5, 2026 (100 = Sep 2026), across 95 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $1,158. Over the latest month it moved −24.8% (from Oct 8, 2026).
